sections.t: Rest day as planned, and nothing was logged. That leaves one lifting session done this week so far, Tuesday's Lower A.

Lower B: hip thrust machine 4x6-10, RDL 3x6-10, leg press feet high 3x10-15, cable kickback 3x12-15. No run and no ab work today. On the RDL, push your hips back until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then stop before your back rounds.
Aim for about 30 to 40 g of protein at each meal to reach 130 g within about 1,750 kcal. Have Protein overnight oats before the gym and a Tuna rice bowl afterwards.
Wednesday's Upper A and easy run were missed, and nothing ran this week yet. Keep Sunday's long run to about 3.3 km at an easy 8:30 to 9:00/km, since your longest run in the past 30 days is 3.0 km.
